versions.subject: Windows T1049 RedCannary
versions.detection:
netstat:
    CommandLine|contains: netstat
net_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains: 'net '
net_opt:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - use
        - sessions
condition: netstat or (net_cmd and net_opt)

versions.subject: Windows redcannary
versions.detection:
netstat:
    CommandLine|contains: netstat
net_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains: 'net '
net_opt:
    - CommandLine|endswith:
        - ' use'
        - ' sessions'
    - CommandLine|contains:
        - ' use '
        - ' sessions '
condition: netstat or (net_cmd and net_opt)
versions.spl: CommandLine="*netstat*" OR (CommandLine="*net *" CommandLine IN ("* use", "* sessions") OR CommandLine IN ("* use *", "* sessions *"))

        - '\net.exe'
        - '\net1.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
        - 'net.exe'
        - 'net1.exe'
selection_cli:
    - CommandLine|endswith:
        - ' use'
        - ' sessions'
    - CommandLine|contains:
        - ' use '
        - ' sessions '
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\net.exe", "*\\net1.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("net.exe", "net1.exe") CommandLine IN ("* use", "* sessions") OR CommandLine IN ("* use *", "* sessions *")
